# {{PROJECT_NAME}}

> HTTP testing workspace powered by HTTP Forge.

## AI Context
- Agent Guide: .http-forge/AGENTS.md (full reference for AI assistants)
- Script API: .http-forge/assets/http-forge-globals.d.ts (pm, ctx, hf, postman, etc.)
- Full docs: https://github.com/hsl1230/http-forge/tree/main/docs/user-guide

## Key concepts
- Collections, requests, folders, environments, scripts (pre-request/post-response)
- Template syntax: {{variable}}, {{$guid}}, {{value | upper | trim}}
- Script API: pm/ctx/hf, pm.test(), pm.expect() (Chai-style), pm.response, pm.request
- Postman-compatible: pm.sendRequest, pm.setNextRequest, postman.* legacy globals
- MCP server for AI-driven testing
- Test suites with control flow (if/for/while/switch)

## Quick reference
- Run collection: http-forge run collection <name> --env <env> --json
- Run suite: http-forge run suite <name> --json
- Discover endpoints: http-forge discover --path <project>
- Generate tests: http-forge qa --path <project> --collection <ref> --base-url <url>
- Design API: http-forge architect "intent" --apply
